get.description: Requires exact current platform context and recent TOTP AAL2 (15 minutes), plus platform.integration.read or platform.announcement.manage. Saving/preferences/self-tests additionally require effective PLATFORM_OWNER. Only the nine existing EMAIL delivery types are exposed: no invented subscription, billing or support delivery. Required recovery/security/invitation messages cannot be disabled; only invitation reminders are optional. Updates use optimistic If-Match, actor-scoped UUID idempotency and atomic revision/audit/outbox writes. Static supported placeholders are strict and one-pass escaped; real tokens/codes are never exposed in previews/history. Template field lengths are UTF-8 byte limits.

Required recovery/security/invitation messages cannot be disabled; only invitation reminders are optional. Updates use optimistic If-Match, actor-scoped UUID idempotency and atomic revision/audit/outbox writes. Static supported placeholders are strict and one-pass escaped; real tokens/codes are never exposed in previews/history. Template field lengths are UTF-8 byte limits. Sends synthetic values only to the requesting administrator's server-resolved verified email, using current exact-active SMTP and existing delivery evidence. SMTP_ACCEPTED is not recipient delivery. At most three claims per actor per ten minutes. Pending/ambiguous attempts are never automatically retried. Communications history exposes safe platform test outcomes, not recipients or bodies.
